component.name: Screen Orientation Manager
component.summary: Rotate the touchscreen, display, and touchpad orientation for convertible laptops and tablets (X11 only)

description.p: Screen Orientation Manager is a simple GTK3 application for X11-based desktop environments that allows you to manually or automatically rotate the display, touchscreen, and touchpad orientation on convertible laptops and tablets. It supports device autodetection, stylus support, and provides a system tray icon for quick access.

ul.li: Manual and automatic rotation for display, touchscreen, and touchpad
Autodetection of known devices
Colorful buttons for orientation actions
System tray icon (Ayatana AppIndicator) for quick access
Remembers device configuration
Can be invoked from the command line with arguments
Add command line arguments
Add support for Acer Aspire SW5-012
Fix stylus code
Add autodetect support for Microsoft Surface RT
Add autodetect support for Blooguard
Add colorful buttons for Left, Normal, Right, Invert, and Autodetect actions
Add stylus support
Autodetect support
Allow selecting text in messages
Fixed application icon not appearing in the XFCE dock by adding StartupWMClass to desktop file
Added direct orientation change options (Left, Normal, Right, Invert) to the system tray menu for quicker access
Added optional system tray icon (Ayatana AppIndicator) for quick access and background operation
Window now minimizes to tray instead of closing (if tray is available)
Manually rotate touchscreen and touchpad input for laptops/tablets
Simple GTK3 interface with configurable touchpad xinput ID
Saves device configuration for future sessions
